specs.authoredModuleSummary: This module builds the MCP metadata, including the component/pattern/token catalog and the associated image catalog, used by the MCP server's tools.
specs.name: scripts/build-mcp-metadata.ts

specs.authoredModuleSummary: A build script that assembles a talk piece's runtime artifacts and manifest from the design system's components.
specs.name: scripts/build-pieces.mjs

specs.authoredModuleSummary: Check-runtime is a validation script with an embedded server that verifies runtime page-serving behavior, such as path-based routing requirements, stays correct as the design system evolves.
specs.name: scripts/check-runtime.mjs

specs.authoredModuleSummary: Tag-contract defines and validates the per-component tag contract used to determine ownership, node classification, descriptions, and prop listings for design system components, raising an error when a module lacks a contract.
specs.name: scripts/lib/tag-contract.mjs

specs.authoredModuleSummary: A Firebase-targeted build script for the MCP server, responsible for producing the deployable artifact that serves the design system's MCP tools over Firebase hosting.
specs.name: scripts/build-mcp-firebase.ts

specs.authoredModuleSummary: Check-islands.mjs is a validation script that checks island hydration correctness within the design system's rendered output, currently failing most of its checks.
specs.name: scripts/check-islands.mjs

specs.authoredModuleSummary: A command line check script that renders or inspects pieces to validate the dom they produce, serving as the harness-invoked entry point for piece structural checks.
specs.name: scripts/check-pieces.mjs

specs.authoredModuleSummary: A command line script that validates primitive-level design system components.
specs.name: scripts/check-primitives.mjs

specs.authoredModuleSummary: Pieces-harness is a test harness module providing utilities to open, load, and inspect rendered pieces for use by validation check scripts like check-islands and check-pieces.
specs.name: scripts/lib/pieces-harness.mjs

specs.authoredModuleSummary: A small module providing a Preact aliasing utility, exporting one operation, with no recorded requirements or incoming calls visible to the call graph.
specs.name: scripts/lib/preact-alias.mjs
